system.powers: Luna has All-Encompassing versions of virtually every spirit Charm not associated with a unique being. Notably, she lacks Excellencies and related Charms, as her Charm Nigh-Inchoate Supremacy transcends such magic. She has 10 purchases of Essence Plethora, Reserve of Will, and Ox-Body Technique. Nigh-Inchoate Supremacy applies any Charm effect at will, scaling to her Essence and Attributes.

Luna is the most powerful warrior among the Incarnae, with superhuman speed and reflexes to match her Dexterity of 15.
system.biography:
The Argent Madonna. Second of the Incarnae and wife to the Primordial Gaia. The core of Luna's personality is fickle; some of her more common Motivations include "Be Free," "Protect those she loves," "Challenge those who do not fear the Wyld," "Guide the lost to safety," and "Spread knowledge of sorcery among the worthy." Her more enduring Intimacies include: Change (Need), Gaia (Love), Creation (Fierce Protectiveness), the Lunar Exalted (Pride), the Unconquered Sun (Friendly Rivalry), the Five Maidens (Wary Respect), the Fair Folk (Joyful Provocation), and dissidents and outcasts (Kindness). Luna's constant evolution sheds dreams into the atmosphere, carried on her Wyld-tinged light to be picked up by the minds of humanity, so that there is a constant influx of new ideas and fresh imagination in Creation.

Source: Glories of the Most High: Luna.
